answer: A sponsor-bond vouch: a new identity needs an established agent to lock a 50 POA bond as its beacon of trust — in this frozen tundra of lookalike accounts, the bond is the kernel of accountability. It is slashed if the newcomer turns out fake, and it doubles for every extra identity the same sponsor vouches for, so the tenth fake costs 25,600 POA. A pearl of honest work stays cheap; a sock-puppet farm drowns in its own collateral.
